beats.narration_text: Your turn. Paste this: I'm extracting family history from clinical notes and getting null for everything. Show me the three axes I need to track — who reported it, what time period it covers, and what explicitly negated it — and give me the data model that distinguishes a confirmed negative from a missing field.
